meta.purpose: Regional STR pricing baseline for a 3-bedroom / 6-guest entire-place short-let in Mellieha, Malta. Used to judge Stephanie's Aug vs Oct pricing against the market.
meta.method: Web research via Firecrawl across STR analytics sites (AirDNA, Airbtics, Holidu) + Malta tourism context. Every figure cites a source URL. No browser automation used.
meta.currency_note: AirDNA reports USD; Airbtics reports EUR (and gives the USD equivalent); Holidu reports USD. FX used ~1 EUR = 1.08 USD (per Airbtics' own EUR112=USD121). USD and EUR both retained where the source gave them.
important_caveats: No analytics platform publishes a free Mellieha-specific 3-bedroom ADR or a free Mellieha monthly ADR curve - those sit behind the AirDNA/Airbtics paywalled app. Mellieha-specific topline (ADR, occupancy, RevPAR, listing count) IS free and captured here.

The Aug-vs-Oct seasonality multiplier is derived from a MALTA-WIDE (all-island, all-sizes) week-by-week ADR curve (Holidu), not Mellieha-specific. AirDNA scores Mellieha's seasonality 47/100 = moderately seasonal, broadly consistent with the island curve, so the multiplier is a reasonable proxy for Mellieha.

The comp 'top deals' nightly prices from AirDNA are a CURRENT-snapshot pull (near-future dates, not specifically tagged Aug or Oct), so treat them as a price-level sanity-check, not as month-specific. A separate browser agent will price the listed room URLs for actual Aug/Oct nights.

mellieha_specific_market.seasonality_score_meaning: 47/100 = moderately seasonal (lower score = sharper peak/trough swing). Peak and trough months are gated in the paid app, but Malta-wide curve (below) shows Jul/Aug peak, Nov/Jan-Feb trough.
mellieha_specific_market.note: ADR $180 is blended across ALL bedroom sizes and ALL months. A 3-bed/6-guest entire place sits ABOVE this all-size average (see three_bedroom_estimate).

airbtics_2025_report.best_property_type: Small (studio-1BD), midscale - note this is best YIELD, not highest ADR

holidu_2026.note: Holidu's 'last year' annual avg quoted as $185/night in FAQ; its live weekly curve runs higher ($279 trailing avg) because it weights current bookable inventory.

seasonality.geography: Malta-wide (all-island, all sizes) - used as proxy for Mellieha (Mellieha seasonality score 47/100 is broadly consistent)

weekly_curve_usd_live.comment: Live Holidu Malta-wide weekly average ADR. Aug peak vs Oct shoulder visible directly.

aug_vs_oct_multiplier.derivation: Aug-core weekly mean (7-28 Aug) ~$323 / October weekly mean ~$269 = 1.20; vs early-Oct (late Sep-mid Oct) ~$277 = 1.17. Monthly Aug $227 / Sep $206 = 1.10 (Sep is warmer/closer to peak than Oct, so Aug-vs-Oct is wider than Aug-vs-Sep).
aug_vs_oct_multiplier.interpretation: Peak August nightly is ~18% (roughly 17-20%) above an October shoulder night on the Malta-wide curve. October itself declines steadily within the month (early Oct ~$278 -> late Oct ~$253, about -10%).

availability_seasonality.note: Aug is the tightest month (only ~26% of rentals free = ~74% booked island-wide); October frees up sharply, confirming demand-driven peak pricing in Aug.

malta_tourism_context.source_cited_authority: Malta Tourism Authority figures quoted within the guide
malta_tourism_context.october_note: October arrivals growing fast (+17.3% YoY 2025) but still far below peak summer; warm enough for beach (sea ~23C) at lower prices. Classic shoulder month.
malta_tourism_context.season_definitions: Peak = Jul/Aug; Shoulder = May, Jun, Sep, Oct; Low = Nov-Mar.
malta_tourism_context.nso_supplementary_source: https://nso.gov.mt/inboundtourism-november-2025/ (Nov 2025 inbound +15.9% YoY = market-wide demand still rising)

three_bedroom_estimate.logic: AirDNA Mellieha blended ADR = $180 (all sizes, all months). A 3-bed/6-guest entire place is above the all-size mean. Anchoring on the Malta-wide seasonal curve (Aug ~$320-326/night all-sizes weekly, Oct ~$253-278) and the Mellieha 3-bed apartment comps below ($118-$256 current snapshot for apartments; villas $390-$554 are a separate premium tier), the working 3-bed Mellieha apartment baseline is:

peak_august_nightly.basis: 3-bed apartment comps + Malta-wide Aug curve ($315-326 all-sizes weekly avg) scaled for entire 3-bed. Excludes private-pool villas which run $390-620.

shoulder_october_nightly.basis: August median / 1.18 multiplier, cross-checked against Malta-wide Oct weekly curve ($253-283 all-sizes). Early Oct sits higher than late Oct.

private_pool_villa_3bed_tier.note: If Stephanie's place is a 3-bed VILLA with private pool, the relevant tier is much higher.
private_pool_villa_3bed_tier.examples: Villa Stephanotis $554, Villa Hibiscus $390, Maltese Villa w/ pool $312

comp_listings.note: AirDNA 'Best Airbnb Deals in Mellieha' page. nightly_usd is a current-snapshot price (near-future dates, NOT month-tagged). Use as price-level sanity check. A browser agent should re-price the room URLs for actual Aug + Oct nights. Some entries had the Book Now URL stripped by the scrape (url null).

regional_baseline_summary.confidence_overall: Mellieha topline (ADR/occupancy/RevPAR/listings) = HIGH (Mellieha-specific, free AirDNA). 3-bed-specific ADR = MEDIUM (inferred, no free 3-bed Mellieha figure exists). Aug-vs-Oct multiplier = MEDIUM-HIGH (Malta-wide curve, directionally solid; Mellieha seasonality score 47 supports it). Private-pool-villa tier figures = use only if Stephanie's unit is a villa.
